businessType.description: Optional business problem type filter, for example crm_single_model_funnel or service_sla.

route.description: Optional preferred route filter, for example DSL_CTE, SQL, or MEMORY_GRID.

namespace.description: Optional local/eval fallback namespace. Production callers should pass namespace through MCP context.

tenantId.description: Optional local/eval fallback tenant id. Production callers should pass X-Tenant-Id through MCP headers.

permissionTags.description: Optional local/eval fallback permission tags. Production authorization should come from X-Roles or X-Permission-Tags headers.

ownerRoles.description: Optional owner/delegation filter. Production delegation should come from X-Recipe-Owner-Roles header.

limit.description: Maximum number of discoverable experience recipes to return.
